_status: Module 4, Lesson 4.2 'Look-alike addresses' (learner guide of 21 October 2026): the fictional RSSO Assistance Portal at assist.rsso-q.example and the guide's three look-alikes. .example names are reserved for documentation (RFC 2606), so none of them can be a real site.

cases.note: Find the first single slash after https://, then read the words just before it from right to left: the owner is **rsso-q.example**. The real portal (fictional).
**A swapped character:** a zero, not the letter o. It has a padlock too: the padlock means private, not honest.
**Extra words:** "rsso-q-payout" is a different name, owned by whoever registered it.
**The real name at the front, the owner at the end.** Read right to left from the first single slash: the owner is **verify-account.example**, not the RSSO.
